body.name: RTC-law event-curve protocol
body.construction: On the 1977--2014 right-to-carry panel, retain the 44 states with at least eight pre-adoption observations, define \(G_i\) by the law's first effective year, apply \(\mathcal C_n\) to the eligible post-adoption subcurve \(k=0,\ldots,10\), retain \(k=-20,\ldots,-1\) as an observed pre-fit diagnostic outside the band theorem, and residualize the optional unit and calendar effects before block completion.
